rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for physical electronic devices, especially consumer items.

example.english: All the electronics at home need charging.
example.traditional: 我屋企啲電子產品全部都要叉電。
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 di1 din6 zi2 caan2 ban2 cyun4 bou6 dou1 jiu3 caa1 din6

rows.note: Use this for electronics as an academic or technical field of study.

example.english: I'm studying electronics and want to become an engineer after graduation.
example.traditional: 我讀緊電子學，畢業後想做工程師。
example.jyutping: ngo5 duk6 gan2 din6 zi2 hok6 bat1 jip6 hau6 soeng2 zou6 gung1 cing4 si1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the electronic circuitry inside a device or system.

example.english: The electronics in this device are broken, so it won't turn on.
example.traditional: 呢部機嘅電子線路壞咗，所以開唔到。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gei1 ge3 din6 zi2 sin3 lou6 waai6 zo2 so2 ji5 hoi1 m4 dou2
